arxiv-2009-04069.description: Abstract Letting G = F / R G=F/R be a finitely-presented group, Hopf’s formula expresses the second integral homology of G G in terms of F F and R R . Expanding on previous work, we explain how to find generators of H 2 ​ ( G , 𝔽 p ) H_{2}(G;\mathbb{F}_{p}) .

arxiv-2101-06862.title: Same-Sign Dilepton Signature in the Inert Doublet Model
arxiv-2101-06862.creator: Fa-Xin Yang, Zhi-Long Han, Yi Jin
arxiv-2101-06862.description: Abstract In this paper, we perform a detailed analysis on the same-sign dilepton signature in the inert doublet model. Focusing on the low dark matter mass region, we randomly scan the corresponding parameter space. Viable samples allowed by various constraints are obtained, among which twenty benchmark points are selected for further collider signature study.

arxiv-2102-10013.title: Curvy: An Interactive Design Tool for Varying Density Support Structures
arxiv-2102-10013.creator: E. Ulu 1 N. Gecer Ulu 1 J. Li 2 and W. Hsiao 1 1 Palo Alto Research Center, USA 2 UCLA HCI Research, USA
arxiv-2102-10013.description: Abstract We introduce Curvy–an interactive design tool to generate varying density support structures for 3D printing. Support structures are essential for printing models with extreme overhangs. Yet, they often cause defects on contact areas, resulting in poor surface quality. Low-level design of support structures may alleviate such negative effects.

arxiv-2201-08108.title: Ubiquitous Coexisting Electron-Mode Couplings in High Temperature Cuprate Superconductors
arxiv-2201-08108.creator: Hongtao Yan 1,2 , Jin Mo Bok 3 , Junfeng He 1† , Wentao Zhang 1‡ , Qiang Gao 1 , Xiangyu Luo 1,2 , Yongqing Cai 1 , Yingying Peng 1§ , Jianqiao Meng 1¶ , Cong Li 1 , Hao Chen 1,2 , Chunyao Song 1,2 , Chaohui Yin 1,2 , Taimin Miao 1,2 , Genda Gu 4 , Chengtian Lin 5 , Fengfeng Zhang 6 , Feng Yang 6 ,
arxiv-2201-08108.description: Abstract In conventional superconductors, the electron-phonon coupling plays a dominant role in pairing the electrons and generating superconductivity. In high temperature cuprate superconductors, the existence of the electron coupling with phonons and other boson modes and its role in producing high temperature superconductivity remain unclear.

arxiv-2211-11888.title: Precision education: A Bayesian nonparametric approach for handling item and examinee heterogeneity in assessment data
arxiv-2211-11888.creator: Tianyu Pan, Weining Shen, Clintin P. Davis-Stober, Guanyu Hu
arxiv-2211-11888.description: Abstract We propose a novel nonparametric Bayesian IRT model in this paper by introducing the clustering effect at question level and further assume heterogeneity at examinee level under each question cluster, characterized by the mixture of Binomial distributions. The main contribution of this work is threefold: (1) We demonstrate that the model is identifiable.

arxiv-2212-07448.description: Abstract Context. FG Sge has evolved from the hot central star of the young planetary nebula Hen 1-5 to a G–K supergiant in the last 100 years. It is one of the three born-again objects that has been identified as of yet, and they are considered to have undergone a thermal pulse in the post-asymptotic giant branch evolution. Aims.

arxiv-2304-10682.title: Multiple-scattering model for the effective refractive index of dense suspensions of forward-scattering particles Journal: osajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2304-10682.creator: Alexander Nahmad-Rohen \authormark 1,* and Augusto García-Valenzuela \authormark 1
arxiv-2304-10682.description: Abstract We present a multiple-scattering model for the effective refractive index of an arbitrarily dense suspension of forward-scattering particles. The model provides a very simple formula for the effective refractive index of such a suspension and reproduces with high accuracy available experimental results.

arxiv-2305-02785.title: How to play the Accordion: Uniformity and the (non-)conservativity of the linear approximation of the λ-calculus
arxiv-2305-02785.creator: Rémy Cerda, Lionel Vaux Auclair
arxiv-2305-02785.description: Abstract Twenty years after its introduction by Ehrhard and Regnier, differentiation in λ-calculus and in linear logic is now a celebrated tool. In particular, it allows to write the Taylor formula in various λ-calculi, hence providing a theory of linear approximations for these calculi.

arxiv-2404-19743.title: Comparative Analysis of Fluctuations in Viscoelastic Stress: A Comparison of the Temporary Network and Dumbbell models
arxiv-2404-19743.creator: Arturo Winters, Hans Christian Öttinger, Jan Vermant
arxiv-2404-19743.description: Abstract Abstract. Traditionally, stress fluctuations in flowing and deformed materials are overlooked, with an obvious focus on average stresses in a continuum mechanical approximation. However, these fluctuations, often dismissed as “noise” , hold the potential to provide direct insights into the material structure and its structure-stress coupling, uncovering detailed aspects of fluid transport and relaxation behaviors.

arxiv-2508-07187.title: Ferroelectric switching of interfacial dipoles in α \alpha -RuCl 3 /graphene heterostructure
arxiv-2508-07187.creator: Soyun Kim, Jo Hyun Yun, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Joseph Falson, Jun Sung Kim, Kyung-Hwan Jin, Gil Young Cho, Youngwook Kim
arxiv-2508-07187.description: Abstract We demonstrate electrically switchable, non-volatile dipoles in graphene/thin hBN/ α \alpha -RuCl 3 heterostructures, stabilized purely by interfacial charge transfer across an atomically thin dielectric barrier. This mechanism requires no sliding or twisting to explicitly break inversion symmetry and produces robust ferroelectric-like hysteresis loops that emerge prominently near 30 K.

arxiv-2510-23047.title: The universal topological charge of black hole photon spheres in higher dimensions
arxiv-2510-23047.creator: Jun-Lei Chen, Shan-Ping Wu, Shao-Wen Wei
arxiv-2510-23047.description: Abstract A recently developed topological approach offers novel insights into photon spheres, which are fundamental to the formation of black hole shadows. In this study, we extend this topological analysis to higher-dimensional, static, spherically symmetric, and asymptotically flat black holes.

arxiv-2511-00496.title: Evaluating simulation techniques for lubricant distribution in gearboxes Journal: Engineering Applications of Computational Fluid Mechanics
arxiv-2511-00496.creator: Pawan S. Murthy, Anja Lippert, Andrea Beck
arxiv-2511-00496.description: Abstract Efficient lubrication is crucial for the performance and durability of high-speed gearboxes, particularly under varying load conditions. Excess lubrication leads to increased churning losses, while insufficient lubrication accelerates wear on contact surfaces. Due to the high rotational speeds involved, direct experimental visualization of lubricant distribution within gearboxes is challenging, making numerical simulations indispensable.

pmc-13446339.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a common and harmful syndrome associated with sepsis. It is difficult to predict and has an adverse impact on both short- and long-term prognosis. Two urinary biomarkers, tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases-2 (TIMP-2), and insulin-like growth factor-binding protein 7 (IGFBP7) have been validated for predicting moderate and severe AKI and improving the recognition of organ failure in critically ill patients with sepsis.
